newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, nearby month rolled.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, nearby month rolled.

text.p: European broker selling pressured nearby white sugar futures lower on Tuesday despite light support from trade covering of short August positions, market sources said.
One French brokerage was an active seller of both outright August and the nearby spread throughout the day.
This was counterbalanced by purchases from commission houses and other brokerages, some of which was thought to be on behalf of the trade.
"There's been some pressure in August and August/October and a similar sort of thing has been happening in July/October in the U.S. in parallel," said one market source.
"There's been a little bit of covering and profit-taking, even rolling into October," he said.
Traders noted scale buying of August/October as players covered short August positions amid a perception of seasonal tightness into the European summer.
August/October narrowed to $8.00/8.50 after the previous buying seen at $9.00. When this support dried up, the differential naturally contracted, they said.
Very little interest was reported in the August/July arbitrage against New York, traders said.
At 1635 GMT August was down $1.40 at $324.70 and October unchanged at $316.60. Volume amounted to a solid 2,259 lots.
Only the August contract was traded in Paris in a total volume of 87 lots. It was down $1.70 at $324.30.
